title: Wolverine and Ghost of Yōtei up for a Grammy 🏆
subject: grammys
description:
Which soundtrack should win? 👇

The 2027 Grammy nominees for Best Score Soundtrack for Video Games and Other Interactive Media are Marvel's Wolverine, Ghost of Yōtei, 007 First Light, Star Wars Zero Company and Avatar: Frontiers of Pandora's From the Ashes.

Sources: Grammy.com 2027 nominations list, Video Games Chronicle (Nov 16, 2026), Game Informer (Nov 16, 2026)
tags: best score soundtrack for video games

scenes.text: Five game soundtracks are up for a Grammy.
The 2027 nominees, announced November 16: Marvel's Wolverine, Ghost of Yōtei, 007 First Light, Star Wars Zero Company and Avatar's From the Ashes.
Ghost of Yōtei, by Toma Otowa, is the only one not based on a licensed franchise.
Gordy Haab, nominated for Zero Company, is the only past winner. He won in 2024 for Star Wars Jedi: Survivor.
Last time, the award went to Sword of the Sea.
